warnings: Three truss elevations on one sheet (TRUSS T1, T2, T3), all 1:75. Each prints two section callouts: rectangular tube Ø-100x50x1.7 (three leaders: top chord, bottom chord and a vertical) and Ø-75x38x1.7 (one leader: a diagonal). Recorded as steel_section = 100x50x1.7 (chords/verticals) and web_steel_section = 75x38x1.7 (diagonals); the assignment follows the leader ends and is flagged member_assignment_from_leaders. The slashed-rectangle symbol before the size is read as a rectangular hollow section (designation RHS, print kept in printed_as).

Panel chains and the A-D / 1-4 positions under the trusses are recorded in the grid master (dimension_chains); every panel point became a dummy line per section 4 rule 4. T1's 1.30 overhang is taken as the D side (S-03 prints 1.30 below D at grid 4).
web_steel_section is a new key (a truss has two printed member sizes and steel_section must stay one object, section 0.6) — noted so later houses reuse the same name.
